3. Editorial Committee
This Committee consists of five (5) directors, comprising of a Chairman who is an Independent/Non–Executive director and
other directors and regularly invites the Executive management and the respective Managing Editors. The Committee
meets quarterly or as required. The role of the Committee is to develop the Group’s Editorial Policies and provide overall
leadership and oversight over the Group’s journalism and media content.
The Committee met four (4) times during the year.
The current members of the committee are:
